newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL- IBM, Nordstrom up.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL- IBM, Nordstrom up.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp shares climbed to 174-7/8 from 173-1/2 preceding Tuesday's U.S. market open, lifted by Goldman Sachs adding IBM to the firm's recommended and priority lists, traders said.
Yesterday, IBM shares climbed six points to a 52-week high as investors viewed the company as an increasingly secure technology investment.
A source at Goldman said the firm initiated coverage of IBM with the positive recommendation.
Nordstrom Inc shares climbed to 44-3/4 from 42-5/8 after the retailer reported better-than-expected first quarter results, traders said.
Last night, Nordstrom said it earned $0.41 per share in the three months ended April 30, up from $0.32 one year ago.
According to Zack's Investment Research, the consensus estimate for the most recent period was $0.33 per share.
